Model Chi Square + Voting 2 (RF+SVM) menghasilkan akurasi tertinggi 84.6% pada Polarity Dataset 2.0 dan akurasi hingga 92% pada ulasan berbahasa Indonesia.

desc: This paper reviews the evolution and current state of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), emphasizing how IoT technologies are transforming industrial systems through automation, intelligent monitoring, and predictive maintenance. It defines IIoT, outlines recent research advances, and discusses enabling technologies and open challenges for achieving efficiency and productivity in industrial operations.

desc: This study examines the impact of Primary User Emulation Attacks (PUEA) in Cognitive Radio Networks by analyzing the effect of exclusive regions on false alarm and miss detection probabilities. Simulation results show that increasing the exclusion distance from malicious users effectively decreases both error rates, improving network reliability.

desc: This paper presents the experimental design and characterization of a thin tunable absorber based on Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) technology using varactor diodes. The absorber achieves tunable frequency response and improved absorptivity through bias voltage control, demonstrating excellent performance in electromagnetic wave attenuation.

Results indicate that network topology influences key QoS parameters such as throughput, delay, jitter, and packet loss, with linear topology achieving optimal throughput and minimal packet loss.

desc: This paper discusses the design and testing of a 2×2 circular waveguide array antenna optimized for 1800MHz GSM energy harvesting. Experimental results show excellent reflection coefficient and efficiency, highlighting its potential for wireless energy harvesting systems.

A case study in the oil and gas sector illustrates the framework’s effectiveness in maintaining operational continuity and ensuring worker safety.

desc: This study applies cooperative game theory to improve energy-efficient clustering in wireless sensor networks. The proposed Cooperative Game Clustering (CGC) method extends network lifetime and stability compared to traditional LEACH, demonstrating enhanced performance in multi-node environments through cost-sharing cooperation.

desc: This paper presents the design and fabrication of a bandpass filter for short-range radar operating at 24 GHz in the K-band. The filter is implemented using the Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) technique on an RO4003C substrate. Experimental results show good agreement with simulations, although minor deviations occur due to fabrication imperfections.

desc: This review explores key use cases and technologies shaping 5G and future communication systems. It discusses advances in massive MIMO, beamforming, device-to-device communication, NOMA, full-duplex, and cognitive radio. The paper highlights the potential and challenges of each technology in supporting ultra-reliable and high-capacity wireless communication.

Simulation results show that while overloading increases processing time and complexity, MIMO–SCMA achieves better bit error rate performance compared to single SCMA configurations, especially under high connectivity scenarios.

desc: This study compares the LEACH and LEACH-PSO protocols for wireless sensor networks in terms of energy efficiency and network lifetime. Simulation results show that LEACH-PSO achieves better performance by optimizing cluster head selection, reducing overall energy consumption, and extending network lifetime compared to standard LEACH.

The system utilizes a GPS-based geofence and Bluetooth RSSI for adaptive distance measurement, implemented via mobile applications and low-cost wristbands to support COVID-19 quarantine compliance and monitoring.

Sistem memberikan peringatan melalui LED dan buzzer sesuai dengan jarak antar kendaraan untuk membantu pengemudi menjaga jarak aman, dengan tampilan jarak pada LCD secara real-time.

desc: This study introduces a smart control unit to overcome major challenges in Saudi Arabia’s e-commerce environment. Despite the growth of online shopping, several obstacles related to transaction security, reliability, and regulation persist. The proposed system aims to improve the reliability, speed, and security of online transactions by integrating government regulations and technical mechanisms into a unified control framework.

desc: This paper explores cross-layer design techniques in software-defined vehicular networks (SDVNs) using IEEE 802.11bd. The approach integrates transmit antenna selection and power adaptation to address packet blocking issues in dense vehicular environments. Results demonstrate improved throughput and reduced latency, supporting future autonomous and connected vehicle systems within intelligent transportation networks.

desc: This research develops a Bluetooth-based low-cost wearable device designed for self-quarantine monitoring during the COVID-19 pandemic. The system integrates GPS tracking, Bluetooth low energy (BLE), and centralized server monitoring to ensure quarantine compliance. Laboratory testing showed that the device effectively supports real-time location tracking, geofencing, and data transmission with low energy consumption.

desc: This paper discusses methods for reducing common mode noise (CMN) in radar systems to improve detection sensitivity and signal integrity. The study compares several techniques such as proper PCB design, common mode filters, and digital signal processing. Among these, optimized PCB design was identified as the most effective, reducing radar noise interference by up to 20%.

desc: This study explores the use of Raspberry Pi 4 Model B as a low-cost IoT platform. The paper discusses hardware optimization, Python-based development, and integration with IoT networks such as LoRa and ZigBee. Real-time monitoring applications demonstrate the device’s capability for collecting, processing, and visualizing data through cloud platforms like Thingspeak and The Things Network.

Evaluasi dilakukan berdasarkan parameter QoS seperti delay, throughput, dan jitter, dibandingkan dengan standar ITU-T. Hasil simulasi menunjukkan delay rata-rata di bawah 150 ms sehingga jaringan dikategorikan sangat baik untuk layanan triple play.

desc: This study proposes a hybrid synchronization method for OFDM systems that combines symmetric correlation and Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) networks. The approach eliminates the need for prior channel statistics and effectively mitigates multipath interference. Experimental results indicate significant error reduction compared to conventional synchronization techniques.

desc: This paper introduces THRN Plus, an enhanced tiny high-resolution neural network for efficient facial landmark detection. The model improves inference speed through an optimized fusion block and lightweight output module. Experimental results on two benchmark datasets show that THRN Plus achieves higher accuracy and faster performance than existing HRNet-based methods.

desc: This paper investigates a federated meta-learning framework to optimize task offloading and resource allocation in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and Internet of Things (IoT) environments. The approach enhances computational efficiency and reduces latency by distributing learning across multiple MEC nodes, allowing adaptive allocation of limited computing resources while maintaining privacy and scalability.

desc: This survey provides an in-depth analysis of Software Defined Networking (SDN) integration in vehicular communications using IEEE 802.11 and C-V2X technologies. It discusses SDN’s advantages in improving flexibility, low latency, and reliability for vehicular networks. The study also compares the coexistence performance between IEEE 802.11 and C-V2X, highlighting open challenges and potential solutions for future vehicular systems.

desc: This paper proposes a robust interference mitigation method for automotive radar systems based on multiplicative-adaptive filtering and Hilbert transform. The method effectively suppresses interference from nearby radars, improving target detection accuracy even under dense traffic conditions. Simulation results demonstrate enhanced radar signal integrity and robustness against noise.

desc: The study presents FedMeta2Ag, a joint resource management model in MEC-IoT environments using federated meta-learning. By leveraging distributed intelligence, the system dynamically manages resource allocation and computation offloading. Experiments using the MNIST dataset achieved 92% accuracy, outperforming existing models in both convergence speed and predictive precision, demonstrating its suitability for next-generation wireless networks.

desc: Penelitian ini membahas pengembangan front-end website untuk sistem pertanian terpadu skala mikro berbasis IoT yang mengintegrasikan sektor pertanian, peternakan, dan perikanan. Evaluasi terhadap 79 responden menunjukkan tampilan dan navigasi website tergolong baik. Website terbukti responsif di berbagai perangkat dan mampu menampilkan data sensor secara real-time untuk pemantauan budidaya.

desc: Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT untuk pemantauan suhu kandang ayam petelur guna meningkatkan efisiensi peternakan. Sistem otomatis menyalakan kipas pendingin ketika suhu melebihi 25°C dan mematikannya kembali setelah normal. Implementasi ini berhasil meningkatkan efisiensi waktu dan penggunaan energi dalam proses produksi telur ayam.

Sistem ini memungkinkan pengguna memantau data secara real-time melalui antarmuka web. Backend dirancang untuk mendukung komunikasi efisien antar sensor, database, dan pengguna menggunakan teknologi berbasis web modern.

desc: Penelitian ini mengembangkan sistem IoT untuk sektor perikanan, khususnya budidaya ikan lele. Sistem memonitor kekeruhan air dan pH serta mengatur pemberian pakan otomatis. Ketika pH air berada di luar rentang 6.5–8.5 atau kekeruhan melebihi 50 NTU, sistem secara otomatis mengaktifkan sirkulasi air. Implementasi ini meningkatkan efisiensi waktu dan kualitas lingkungan kolam ikan.

title: Multi-Function Coastal Radar for Tsunami Detection And Ocean Tide and Wave Monitoring
desc: This study focuses on Tsunami detection using SIMRAD Radar. A tsunami can cause severe damage and loss of life. As an archipelagic nation, Indonesia must apply appropriate technology such as smart radar that can detect high sea waves from tens to hundreds of kilometers away. This system provides rapid information for emergency response teams to notify communities of potential tsunamis. The research includes the comprehensive measurement of the SIMRAD Radar Helo 6 integrated with SBE 26Plus data for marine monitoring. The radar, positioned along the coast, and SBE26Plus, placed in the ocean, provide real-time measurements for sea level and wave monitoring.

author: Nasrullah Armi
title: Optimasi Penginderaan Spektrum Pada Radio Kognitif Untuk Mengatasi Kelangkaan Frekuensi Dalam Sistem Komunikasi Nirkabel
desc: Jumlah pengguna perangkat nirkabel yang meningkat pesat menyebabkan kelangkaan spektrum frekuensi. Teknologi akses spektrum dinamis diperlukan agar pengguna dapat berpindah frekuensi secara fleksibel tanpa perubahan perangkat keras. Penelitian ini membahas dua metode utama dalam teknologi penginderaan dan akses spektrum dinamis, yaitu lapisan bawah (underlay) dan lapisan atas (overlay). Sistem radio kognitif menjadi solusi efisien dengan kemampuan mendeteksi dan menggunakan spektrum yang tidak terpakai, memastikan komunikasi nirkabel yang efisien dan tidak saling mengganggu.

The approach performs line fitting to correct incomplete point cloud data caused by reflection or obstacles during scanning. Using a 2D YDLIDAR G4 sensor with 7 Hz frequency, the method successfully reconstructs room maps with high accuracy. Increasing data input improves the likelihood of accurate model generation.

Penelitian ini menerapkan teknologi IoT untuk memantau kualitas air dan pemberian pakan ikan patin secara real-time. Sistem ini meningkatkan efisiensi dan efektivitas pengelolaan, serta membantu menjaga stabilitas ekosistem akuaponik agar mendukung pertumbuhan ikan dan tanaman dengan optimal.

Dengan menggabungkan ikan dan tanaman, sistem ini membutuhkan pemantauan intensif terhadap pH air, nutrisi, ketinggian air, dan intensitas cahaya. Sistem IoT memungkinkan pengumpulan dan pengiriman data secara otomatis tanpa intervensi manusia, sehingga meningkatkan efektivitas pemeliharaan budidaya akuaponik.

Data ditampilkan pada platform Blynk Cloud dengan nilai rata-rata emisi sebesar 946 ppm saat idle dan 1235 ppm saat berjalan. Sistem ini dapat membantu pengendara memantau kesehatan kendaraan dan kualitas emisi guna mendukung lingkungan yang lebih bersih.

Sistem mampu memantau suhu mesin, suhu transmisi, serta kondisi kendaraan lainnya. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan sistem berfungsi efektif dalam memberikan informasi kondisi kendaraan, yang dapat membantu mengurangi risiko kecelakaan akibat kerusakan mekanis.

Sistem menggunakan sensor pH, TDS, dan suhu yang terhubung ke NodeMCU ESP32. Data dikirimkan secara real-time ke aplikasi Blynk untuk pemantauan dan pengaturan otomatis pompa air.
